OCTG
OCTG supplier offering API 5CT casing, tubing and drill pipe in J55, K55, N80, L80 and P110 grades.
More products
Eastern Steel supplies oil country tubular goods (OCTG) for oil and gas drilling, well completion and production, including casing & tubing, drill pipe and pup joints.
OCTG Products
Casing & Tubing
Casing and tubing are supplied for wellbore support and fluid production, with applicable API specifications, grades, sizes and connection types.
Drill Pipe
Drill pipe is used for drilling operations to connect surface equipment with the drill bit and circulate drilling fluid, with applicable API specifications and grades.
Pup Joints
Pup joints are short tubular sections used to adjust the length of casing, tubing or drill pipe strings and accommodate downhole tool positioning.
Eastern Steel technical team is available to provide project-based recommendations.
